name: Airport Terminal Snyder's of Hanover Gluten-Free Mini Pretzels
whyItWorks: Crunchy corn and potato starch pretzels with fine sea salt. Gluten-free, ultra-low in fat, non-greasy, and provides crucial sodium to maintain fluid retention at high altitudes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Available in single-serve bags at newsstands and Hudson News racks.
